findings.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Handle the response waiter rejection before starting navigation**

If the initial map navigation fails or times out before the territorial endpoint responds, `page.goto()` throws before `incoming` is awaited. The pending `waitForResponse()` then rejects on timeout or when the browser is closed in `finally`, leaving an unhandled rejection. Node can consequently terminate while cleanup is still running, skipping the owned-server shutdown, schema teardown, and failure receipt. Attach rejection handling immediately and settle the response waiter together with navigation so this error path reaches the existing cleanup and receipt logic.
